about: Scheduler grammar 2: every built-in an event can call, the modules and functions its expressions can use, the slot names, the limits, and every diagnostic the grammar checker answers with its message template. Read by both validators (screenplan_contracts.event_grammar and @screenplan/script-actions scheduler-grammar-v2), the studio editor and the generated docs. Every name here starts with a lowercase letter, so no capitalized workspace name can ever collide with one (workspace docs/specs/scheduler-python-grammar.md, "Names"). Adding a built-in is an entry here plus its handler in the scheduler.

slots.about: A slot is a kind and a number (device-slots spec): device0, phone0, phone1, tablet0, desktop0, desktop1…

builtins.name: target_host

params.name: names
params.doc: A host name or host-mapping keyword, or a list of them.

builtins.help: The block runs only on these hosts. Outside any target_host, an event runs on every host's scheduler. A target_host inside another one replaces it.

builtins.name: target_device

params.name: name
params.doc: The device to bind it to.

builtins.help: Binds a slot to a device for the scripts in the block: always both, the slot and the device (the one-argument form no longer runs).

builtins.name: timeout
builtins.help: Scripts started in the block get at most this long, and never run past the event's end.

builtins.name: parallel
builtins.help: Scripts in the block start without waiting for each other; the block ends when all of them have. Directly inside: script calls, start_device, stop_device, assignments, extend_end, and if/for blocks made of those.

builtins.name: restart_device_on_crash

params.name: name
params.doc: The device to restart; any device when left out.

builtins.help: Scripts in the block restart that device (any device with no argument) when they crash.

builtins.name: start_device

params.name: name
params.doc: The device to bind it to first.

builtins.help: Starts the device in that slot, binding it first when a name is given.

builtins.name: stop_device

params.name: name
params.doc: The device to bind it to first.

builtins.help: Stops the device in that slot.

builtins.name: delay_start
builtins.help: Waits a random time in that range.

builtins.name: wait_until
builtins.help: Waits until that long after the event's start.

builtins.name: extend_end

params.name: min_seconds
params.doc: The least extra time, in seconds.

params.name: max_seconds
params.doc: The most extra time, in seconds.

builtins.help: Moves the event's end later by a random amount in that range.

builtins.name: dropout_chance
builtins.help: With probability p, skips the rest of the current sequence (the whole event at the top level, the rest of the iteration in a loop).

builtins.name: run_event

params.name: path
params.doc: The saved Control Board event, Folder/Title.

builtins.help: Runs a saved Control Board event here, in its own scope. Keyword arguments set its parameter() values. The calling event's context applies to it.

builtins.name: parameter

params.name: default
params.doc: The value a scheduled run uses (input).

builtins.help: A Control Board run asks for the value; the panel replaces the call with the chosen literal. A scheduled run uses default, the first option, or []. Written as name = parameter(…).

functions.name: len
functions.doc: The length of a list, tuple, dict or string.

functions.name: int
functions.doc: A value as a whole number.

loopFunction.name: range
loopFunction.doc: range(N), range(start, stop) or range(start, stop, step), each a number written in the event: only as the count of a for loop.

modules.name: math
modules.doc: Any function or constant of Python's math module.

modules.name: datetime
modules.doc: datetime.datetime.now() and datetime.timedelta(…), and the attributes and methods of what they return.
